definitions.preparation_s: Target preparation start -> admission complete (Kimi). GLM measured preparation window, sometimes prior pool unload. Not pure fill.
definitions.preparation_to_startup_gap_s: Admission/preparation completion -> same HTTP producer registration command invocation.
definitions.command_to_route_s: Same producer register command invocation -> real router_instance_published for matched model/instance.
definitions.route_to_backend_first_token_s: Matched route publication -> backend_first_token_observed for arithmetic requestID/backend owner. Not client streaming TTFT.
definitions.backend_first_token_to_correct_http_s: Same arithmetic backend observation -> client received_ns after HTTP parsing/context close, prior validation/save. Not pure generation or last-token timestamp.
definitions.identity: First3 segment tail sums A. Five mutually exclusive contiguous segments sum Prep+Gap+A. All Kimi endpoint clock domains boot/timens/implementation equal, router/backend startticks and container cgroup match recorded owners. PID values are namespace-specific, not equated hostPID with containerPID.
definitions.limits: Common initialization/pool creation and deletion/cleanup/release outside plotted window. GLM phase-ingestion and Kimi model-loading overlap other spans and are not added. No new p tests/causal claim or missing-value imputation.
